reviews.comment:
Excelente atención. Baños muy limpios, gracias  Paula por su amabilidad. Funciona todo. La cafetería excelente, con vistas al ex camping en estado de abandono por cuestiones legales ,  con gran arboleda e instalaciones para la recreación y el descanso . Un verdadero pulmón y reserva urbana que, lamentablemente, está fuera del uso público.

(Translated by Google)
Excellent service. Very clean restrooms, thank you Paula for your kindness. Everything works. The café is excellent, overlooking the former campsite, now abandoned due to legal issues, with a large grove of trees and facilities for recreation and relaxation. A true green space and urban reserve that, unfortunately, is closed to the public.
